name: Master Rune
source:
While forces the world over scramble to fill the power vacuum left in the wake of his master's death, Rune travels to Japan to attend the prestigious Saisu Academy of Magic. There, he'll make new friends, help them with their problems, [s]stare into the abyss[/s], and maybe even fall in love.

[From [url=https://lizardsfromspace.itch.io/master-rune]itch.io[/url]]
